_about: Albion Woodbury Small (1854-1926), founder of the first American department of sociology (Chicago) and of the American Journal of Sociology. Raw IA OCR: General Sociology, an exposition of the main development in sociological theory from Spencer to Ratzenhofer (University of Chicago Press, copyright 1905, this printing 1907); The Meaning of Social Science (University of Chicago Press, published November 1910). His surname is a common word, so only full name forms are used. US public domain. No uids minted.
